info.name: Saga Choreography Movie Booking
info.description: HTTP requests for the movie booking saga. Booking Service exposes the HTTP API; Seat Inventory and Payment are Kafka-driven consumers and are observed in their application logs.

item.name: Book available seat (simulated payment success)
item.description: Uses seeded seat A1. The payment service succeeds for amounts at or below 2000. Confirm the asynchronous result in the Booking, Seat Inventory, and Payment service logs.

item.name: Book available seat (simulated payment failure)
item.description: Uses seeded seat A2. Amounts above 2000 trigger simulated payment failure and seat release. Run after importing the seed data; inspect service logs for the asynchronous rollback.
